worldcombat.skill.outrage.summary: Lock onto one foe and ram it headlong again and again: each charge deals contact damage and hurls the target back, the last one multiplies by the finisher; afterwards the user reels in confusion and its actions may fumble.
worldcombat.skill.outrage.use.0: Stick to one key target and shove it out of formation
worldcombat.skill.outrage.use.1: Finish a low target with the finisher charge
worldcombat.skill.outrage.use.2: Grind one opponent down with high repeated contact damage
worldcombat.skill.outrage.description.0: Pursue the chosen target for %2$s charges of %1$s power. An enemy in the lane can intercept a charge; the last charge gains a %3$s finisher multiplier.
worldcombat.skill.outrage.description.1: Each charge reaches up to %1$s blocks and they are %2$s apart; the collision radius is %3$s blocks and a hit hurls the target %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.outrage.description.2: Afterwards the user is confused for %1$s, and each attempted action has a %2$s chance to fumble and take backlash.
worldcombat.skill.outrage.relentless.on: Relentless form: charges further, hurls the target harder and hits a heavier finisher, but has a slower wind-up and cooldown and a longer daze.
worldcombat.skill.outrage.relentless.off: Dashing form: closes tighter, keeps a faster rhythm and recovers sooner, but cannot reach distant targets.
worldcombat.skill.outrage.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP; cooldown %5$s s from commitment.
worldcombat.skill.outrage.growth.0: From level %1$s each charge rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.outrage.growth.1: From level %1$s each charge rises to %2$s and the finisher to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.outrage.preference.rel: On: charges further, hurls the target harder and hits a heavier finisher, but has a slower wind-up and cooldown and a longer daze - for pinning down runners. Off (dashing): closes tighter, keeps a faster rhythm and recovers sooner, but cannot reach distant targets.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts rampages sooner, and is easier to whiff.
On: below a third health the target is prioritized for a finisher charge. Off: the move keeps its normal priority.
